{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CacheClient where

import System.Process (readProcess, callCommand)
import System.IO (hSetBuffering, BufferMode(..), Handle, hPutStrLn, hGetLine, hClose, hFlush)
import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception (bracket, catch, SomeException, try)
import Data.ByteString.Char8 (pack, unpack)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, intercalate)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, ord)
import System.Exit (ExitCode(..))

data CacheConfig = CacheConfig
  { cacheHost     :: String
  , cachePort     :: Int
  , cacheCluster  :: String
  , shutdownHook  :: String
  , logDir        :: FilePath
  }

data CacheClient = CacheClient
  { config      :: CacheConfig
  , connPool    :: TVar [Socket]
  , isShutdown  :: TVar Bool
  , metrics     :: TVar [(String, Int)]
  }

-- | Validate cache key format: alphanumeric plus colon separator
validateKey :: String -> Bool
validateKey [] = False
validateKey key = all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == ':' || c == '_') key
                  && length key <= 250

-- | Encode a command for the wire protocol
encodeCommand :: String -> String -> String
encodeCommand cmd key = "*2\r\n$" ++ show (length cmd) ++ "\r\n"
                        ++ cmd ++ "\r\n$" ++ show (length key) ++ "\r\n"
                        ++ key ++ "\r\n"

-- | Create a new cache client with connection pooling
newCacheClient :: CacheConfig -> IO CacheClient
newCacheClient cfg = do
  pool <- newTVarIO []
  shut <- newTVarIO False
  met  <- newTVarIO []
  let client = CacheClient cfg pool shut met
  initializePool client 5
  return client

initializePool :: CacheClient -> Int -> IO ()
initializePool client n = do
  let cfg = config client
  socks <- mapM (\_ -> connectToCache (cacheHost cfg) (cachePort cfg)) [1..n]
  atomically $ writeTVar (connPool client) socks

connectToCache :: String -> Int -> IO Socket
connectToCache host port = do
  addr <- resolve host (show port)
  sock <- openSocket addr
  connect sock (addrAddress addr)
  return sock
  where
    resolve h p = do
      let hints = defaultHints { addrSocketType = Stream }
      head <$> getAddrInfo (Just hints) (Just h) (Just p)
    openSocket addr = socket (addrFamily addr) (addrSocketType addr) (addrProtocol addr)

-- | Get a value from the distributed cache
cacheGet :: CacheClient -> String -> IO (Maybe String)
cacheGet client key = do
  shutdown <- atomically $ readTVar (isShutdown client)
  if shutdown
    then return Nothing
    else if validateKey key
      then do
        let cmd = encodeCommand "GET" key
        result <- withConnection client (\sock -> do
          sendAll sock (pack cmd)
          resp <- recv sock 4096
          return $ parseResponse (unpack resp))
        recordMetric client ("get", 1)
        return result
      else return Nothing

-- | Parse the RESP protocol response
parseResponse :: String -> Maybe String
parseResponse ('$':'-':'1':_) = Nothing
parseResponse ('$':rest) = 
  let (lenStr, remainder) = break (== '\r') rest
      payload = drop 2 remainder  -- skip \r\n
  in Just (take (read lenStr) payload)
parseResponse _ = Nothing

withConnection :: CacheClient -> (Socket -> IO a) -> IO a
withConnection client action = do
  sock <- atomically $ do
    pool <- readTVar (connPool client)
    case pool of
      []     -> retry
      (s:ss) -> do
        writeTVar (connPool client) ss
        return s
  result <- action sock
  atomically $ modifyTVar (connPool client) (sock:)
  return result

recordMetric :: CacheClient -> (String, Int) -> IO ()
recordMetric client m = atomically $ modifyTVar (metrics client) (m:)

-- | Graceful shutdown: flush metrics, notify cluster, close connections
gracefulShutdown :: CacheClient -> String -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown client reason = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (isShutdown client) True
  threadDelay 100000  -- allow in-flight requests to complete
  flushMetrics client
  notifyCluster client reason
  drainPool client

-- | Flush accumulated metrics to the log directory
flushMetrics :: CacheClient -> IO ()
flushMetrics client = do
  mets <- atomically $ do
    m <- readTVar (metrics client)
    writeTVar (metrics client) []
    return m
  let logPath = logDir (config client) ++ "/cache_metrics.log"
  writeFile logPath (show mets)

-- | Notify the cluster coordinator about this node's departure
-- Uses the configured shutdown hook to signal the orchestrator
notifyCluster :: CacheClient -> String -> IO ()
notifyCluster client reason = do
  let cfg = config client
      clusterName = cacheCluster cfg
      hook = shutdownHook cfg
      -- Build the notification command using the hook script
      -- The hook is a trusted path from config, reason is the departure message
      notifyCmd = hook ++ " --cluster=" ++ sanitizeClusterArg clusterName
                       ++ " --reason=" ++ formatReason reason
  callCommand notifyCmd

-- | Sanitize cluster name for use in shell command arguments
sanitizeClusterArg :: String -> String
sanitizeClusterArg = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-' || c == '_')

-- | Format the reason string for the notification command
-- Wraps in quotes and escapes internal quotes for shell safety
formatReason :: String -> String
formatReason r = "\"" ++ escapeQuotes r ++ "\""
  where
    escapeQuotes [] = []
    escapeQuotes ('"':cs) = '\\' : '"' : escapeQuotes cs
    escapeQuotes (c:cs) = c : escapeQuotes cs

drainPool :: CacheClient -> IO ()
drainPool client = do
  socks <- atomically $ do
    pool <- readTVar (connPool client)
    writeTVar (connPool client) []
    return pool
  mapM_ close socks
